subject: SELF and SUPER
notes: Rule (--check 8.4.3.8.4 'based upon the set of methods defined for the runtime class of the object referenced by SELF' -> OK §8.4.3.8.4 2)). OoBindByReceiver sets searchRoot = cur for SELF (static roster check per §14.9.23.3 SR4f/g) and binds InvokeForm.Self -> virtual `this.M()`, so dispatch is on the runtime class. oo_self_polymorphic.out = DESCRIBING/WOOF (inherited ANIMAL.DESCRIBE's INVOKE SELF "SOUND" reaches DOG's override). Probe PGR3: A.M's INVOKE SELF "N" on a C object prints C.N (two-level). Factory flavor resolves over FindFactoryMethod (host.OoInFactory). [editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (OO predefined object references; absent from COBOL-85)]
